_about: Observing calendar: the single source for `celestrium calendar` and the website's Dates section. Fields: see WatchEvent in celestrium/watchlist.py. Score an entry when its window closes: set status to passed/failed/lapsed and say what happened in outcome.

events.title: Euclid DR1 (~1900 deg2 wide survey)
events.check: Run the partial-sky dipole estimator same day; DR1 selection is independent of WISE/Gaia.

events.title: Gaia DR4 (66 months; epoch astrometry, photometry and RVS spectra)
events.check: Confirm the date on the ESA Gaia site; pull T CrB / RS Oph epoch photometry and refresh distances.

events.title: Does the Sep 2026 UV collapse recover by orbital phase ~0.3?
events.check: Swift/UVOT UVM2 and XRT 2-10 keV in the newest HEASARC pointings (scripts/novae/fetch_tcrb_swift_uvot.py, fetch_tcrb_swift_xrt.py).
events.test: Geometric (orbit-locked obscuration) if UVM2 brightens by >= 1 mag from the 29 Sep 2026 level by 2026-11-30 (phase 0.3 = 2026-11-12) with the hard X-rays falling again; a change of accretion state if UVM2 stays within 0.5 mag of its quiescent pre-2015 level through 2026-11-30.
events.source: EXP-2026-Y uv_dips (two collapses 5.04 orbits apart, chance p = 0.08)

events.title: Next giant-in-front conjunction (deeper ellipsoidal minimum)
events.check: If a third UV collapse begins within ~0.1 in phase after this date, the orbit-locked hypothesis gains a third coincidence.
events.test: Orbit-locked if a UV collapse (>= 1.5 mag UVM2 in < 45 d) starts between 2027-04-20 and 2027-06-10.

events.title: 1946 analogue window: eruption 0.63 yr after the Sep 2026 UV collapse (2027.38 = 2027-05-19)
events.check: AAVSO alerts / ATels; the overlay stage in scripts/novae/tcrb_analysis.py.
events.test: Analogue survives if T CrB erupts between 2027-03-01 and 2027-08-01; dead (like the 2023 alignment) if no eruption by 2027-08-01.

events.title: Recurrence-clock forecast: 68% window 2027.12-2030.90, median 2028.13
events.check: Score at eruption: where does the date fall in our survival-conditioned log-normal?
events.test: Report the predictive CDF at the eruption date (calibrated forecasts give uniform CDF values).

events.title: Marchev+ ATel 17784 (May 2026): eruption within 5-6 months
events.check: Lapses if no eruption by end of Nov 2026.
events.test: Passes if T CrB erupts by 2026-11-30.

events.title: Iijima 2025: next RS Oph outburst ~Oct-Nov 2026
events.check: Our Swift data show RS Oph quiescent on 2026-09 (UVM2 14.85). Watch AAVSO / ATels.
events.test: Passes if RS Oph erupts by 2026-11-30.

events.title: Pei+ 2026 early branch: eruption Dec 2026 (late branch >= 2029.4)
events.test: Early branch passes if T CrB erupts in Dec 2026.

events.title: Schneider 2024 RNAAS discrete date 2027.106 (2027-02-08)
events.test: Passes if the eruption lands within +/- 2 weeks of 2027-02-08.

events.title: Sello+ 2026: eruption 26 Feb 2027
events.test: Passes if the eruption lands within +/- 2 weeks of 2027-02-26.

events.title: EXP-2026-04 BALD active learning target date

On eruption: score every open T CrB forecast; pull Swift/NuSTAR/Fermi-LAT; check the Shara+ 2024 30 pc super-remnant for a light echo (they predict none); compare the shock X-ray rise with RS Oph 2006/2021 (data/srn/rs_oph).
events.check: Re-run scripts/novae/tcrb_literature.py scoreboard with the eruption date.
events.test: Super-remnant: Shara+ prediction passes if no fluorescent echo is detected.
